title: UX Guidelines for Ecommerce Product Pages (Katie Sherwin, 24 November 2019)
supports: Fetched. Study of 49 ecommerce sites; complete but concise descriptions about use, look and function; key points first; explain terms; consistency across variants; price including product-specific charges; reviewer details and review sorting

title: Product Page UX research and benchmark
supports: Fetched. 344 benchmarked US and European sites; 51% mediocre or worse product page UX; 110+ product page guidelines

title: How Online Reviews Influence Sales (page dated 4 December 2025; findings first published 2017)
publisher: Medill Spiegel Research Center, Northwestern University
supports: Fetched. Five reviews: purchase likelihood 270% greater than none; 190% lower-priced vs 380% higher-priced; peak at 4.0 to 4.7 stars; verified-buyer badge raises odds of purchase by 15%

title: Title [title] and structured title [structured_title] attribute
supports: Fetched. 1 to 150 characters; shoppers often see the first 70 or fewer; key details first; variant details; bundles; no promotional text, price, shipping, company name, caps or symbols; AI-generated titles go in structured_title with trained_algorithmic_media; example title structures

title: Description [description] attribute
supports: Fetched. Up to 5,000 characters; key details in the first 160 to 500; no promotional text, links, comparisons, category references, accessories or business policies; AI-generated descriptions go in structured_description

title: Google Search's guidance on using generative AI content on your website
supports: Fetched. AI content allowed if it meets Search Essentials; scaled content abuse policy; fact-check all AI content, including titles, meta descriptions, structured data and alt text; Merchant Center labelling of AI images, titles and descriptions

title: Influencing your title links in search results
supports: Fetched. Descriptive, concise titles; avoid keyword stuffing and boilerplate; no length limit but truncated; Google may rewrite half-empty, inaccurate or boilerplate titles

title: Introduction to Product structured data
supports: Fetched. Product snippets for pages that don't sell directly versus merchant listings for pages that sell, with shipping, availability, ratings and returns

title: Adding keywords to improve SEO
supports: Fetched. Page title up to 70 characters, 60 to avoid shortening; meta description about 160; H1 built from the title field; at least 250 words of descriptive text; avoid copying manufacturer descriptions; readable alt text

title: Product descriptions with Shopify's AI tools
supports: Fetched. Sidekick writes product descriptions from the Generate text icon; AI outputs can contain errors, so review anything a tool creates or changes

title: An alt Decision Tree (updated 13 May 2024)
supports: Fetched. Informative, functional, decorative, complex and text images and the alt text each needs

title: Advertising FAQ's: A Guide for Small Business (April 2001, edited January 2025)
supports: Fetched. Reasonable basis means objective evidence; guarantees don't replace substantiation; health and safety claims need competent and reliable scientific evidence; price comparison and free offer standards

title: Complying with the Made in USA Standard (July 2024)
supports: Fetched. All or virtually all standard; Labeling Rule (16 CFR 323) finalised 2021 covers labels and online or mail-order materials with a seal, mark, tag or stamp; civil penalties; qualified claims; Assembled in USA conditions

title: Made in USA Rule
supports: Fetched. 16 CFR Part 323; press release 1 July 2021 and Federal Register notice 14 July 2021; enforcement list including Williams-Sonoma and Kubota

title: Williams-Sonoma Will Pay Record $3.17 Million Civil Penalty for Violating FTC Made in USA Order (26 April 2024)
supports: Fetched. $3.175 million, largest Made in USA penalty; Pottery Barn Teen mattress pads described as crafted in America but made in China; breach of 2020 order

title: Threading Your Way Through the Labeling Requirements Under the Textile and Wool Acts (July 2014, edited 2020 and 2025)
supports: Fetched. Catalogue and internet descriptions must state made in USA, imported, or both, matching the label; fibre content in ads that mention a fibre

title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
supports: Fetched. Guides revised in 2023; disclose free products, staff and family links; review gating, delaying negative reviews and five-star-first sorting can mislead; no discounts for positive reviews; typical results

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers (November 2024)
supports: Fetched. 16 CFR Part 465 effective 21 October 2024; bans on fake reviews, sentiment-conditioned incentives, undisclosed insider reviews, company-controlled review sites, suppression and fake social indicators; incentives allowed if not conditioned; civil penalties for knowing violations

title: Fashion Nova will pay $4.2 million as part of settlement of FTC allegations it blocked negative reviews (25 January 2022)
supports: Fetched. Reviews under four stars held and never posted from late 2015 to November 2019; hundreds of thousands of reviews; $4.2 million

title: Green Guides (16 CFR Part 260)
supports: Fetched. Citation; revised Green Guides announced 1 October 2012; general principles, how consumers read claims and how to qualify them

title: Questions and Answers on Directive (EU) 2024/825, empowering consumers for the green transition (September 2026)
publisher: European Commission, DG Justice and Consumers
supports: Fetched (PDF). Applies from 27 September 2026 including old stock; generic environmental claims and examples; recognised excellent environmental performance; specification on the same medium including online selling interface; sustainability labels; offset-based claims; brand and product names; organic terms

title: Green Claims Code: environmental claims on goods and services (20 September 2021)
supports: Fetched. The six principles for environmental claims

title: Press release No 152/24: Judgment in Case C-330/23, Aldi Süd (26 September 2024)
publisher: Court of Justice of the European Union
supports: Fetched (PDF). A reduction announced as a percentage or a promotional price statement must be based on the lowest price in a period not shorter than 30 days before the reduction

title: Price Indication Directive
supports: Fetched. Selling and unit price rules; Article 6a on price reductions; Directive 2019/2161 adopted 27 November 2019, applying from 28 May 2022; Article 6a guidance adopted 17 December 2021

title: Short guide for businesses: publishing consumer reviews and complying with consumer protection law (CMA208, 4 April 2025)
supports: Fetched. Bans on fake reviews, concealed incentivised reviews and false or misleading review information; policy, risk assessment, processes and reasonable and proportionate steps for review publishers

title: CMA fines firms £6 million for misleading sales tactics (14 October 2026)
supports: Fetched. Wayfair £4.8 million for false time-limited Daily Deals and Flash Deals; Appliances Direct and Gold's Gym; DMCC Act direct enforcement; false limited-time offers unfair in all circumstances

title: Open letter to online retailers: including mandatory delivery fees in the total price (2 November 2026)
supports: Fetched. First price seen should be the price paid; mandatory delivery in the total at every stage including product pages; optional charges not hidden behind links or drop-downs

title: Allergen guidance for food businesses (updated 17 July 2026)
supports: Fetched. The 14 allergens; distance selling needs allergen information before purchase and at delivery; free-from claims need strict controls

title: Food Allergies: What You Need to Know (content current as of 3 November 2026)
supports: Fetched. Nine major allergens; sesame from 1 January 2023 under the FASTER Act; declaration in brackets or a Contains statement; may-contain statements voluntary

title: Food labelling: general rules
supports: Fetched. Allergens emphasised in the ingredients list; contains statement where there is no ingredients list
